RCON 601.description: Development of communication skills necessary to foster and develop effective counseling relationships.
RCON 601.subject: RCON
RCON 601.title: Helping Relationships: Fundamentals of Counseling Practice

RCON 605.description: Concepts and procedures relating to disability and culture, covering relevant issues affecting racially and culturally diverse individuals with disabilities, as well as promoting sensitivity and competence. Includes implications for an array of helping professions.
RCON 605.subject: RCON
RCON 605.title: Culture and Disability

RCON 610.description: Contemporary issues related to the provision of effective counseling and rehabilitation services with the lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender (LGBT+) population. The focus will be on attaining a level of applied knowledge and awareness commensurate with professional practice.
RCON 610.subject: RCON
RCON 610.title: LGBT Issues Counseling and Rehabilitation

RCON 680.description: Theories and principles of human development as applied to working with people with disabilities and disadvantagement across the lifespan. Focus on evaluation of the effects of service delivery systems and principal contexts (e.g., the family, peer groups, and culture) on individuals. Application of developmental assessment strategies and interventions that helping professionals can utilize to address clients’ needs and enhance positive potentials.
RCON 680.subject: RCON
RCON 680.title: Human Development and Disability Across the Lifespan

RCON 700.description: Origin, evolution, and future of the rehabilitation counseling profession. Role and functions, scope of practice, and practice settings of rehabilitation counselors.
RCON 700.subject: RCON
RCON 700.title: Foundations of Clinical Rehabilitation Counseling

RCON 701.description: Examines the structure and application of theories of addiction, techniques, strategies, and resources for dealing with a broad range of addictive behavior, including substance related and process, or behavioral, focused, and the environmental, social, and cultural contexts related to addiction.
RCON 701.subject: RCON
RCON 701.title: Foundations in Addictions and Treatment in Counseling

RCON 702.description: Foundations underlying research and assessment methodologies and their application to counseling. Research design, program evaluation, ethical principles in research, the scholarly research process, and statistical software packages.
RCON 702.subject: RCON
RCON 702.title: Introduction to Rehabilitation Research and Program Evaluation

RCON 703.description: Introduction to the origin and evolution of career counseling as well as the social, cultural, and political issues, trends, and organizational variables that impact the field. Presents the role and functions, scope of practice, and practice settings of career counselors.
RCON 703.subject: RCON
RCON 703.title: Foundations in Career Counseling

RCON 704.description: Examines contemporary ethical concerns, issues, decision-making models, and best practices in rehabilitation counseling and the helping professions. Knowledge and awareness appropriate for master's-level professionals with a particular focus on working with people with disabilities or disadvantagement. Application of knowledge across a range of helping relationships.
RCON 704.subject: RCON
RCON 704.title: Ethics in Rehabilitation Counseling and Helping Relationships

RCON 711.description: Individual counseling theories and techniques applied to a wide range of persons, including persons with a disability (emotional, psychosocial, mental, and physical) and disadvantaged persons.
RCON 711.subject: RCON
RCON 711.title: Rehabilitation Counseling Theories and Practice

RCON 712.description: Examines theories and principles of family systems and systems-based approaches as applied to working with people with substance use disorders and/or addictive behaviors and their families.
RCON 712.subject: RCON
RCON 712.title: Addiction and the Family

RCON 714.description: Assessment in clinical rehabilitation, including assessment instruments, methods, materials, and interpretation as applied to a variety of rehabilitation clients. Concepts, skill development, and application of clinical rehabilitation assessment.
RCON 714.subject: RCON
RCON 714.title: Rehabilitation Assessment

RCON 720.description: Principles and practice of group counseling techniques applied to a wide range of persons, including persons with a disability (emotional, psychosocial, mental, and physical) or disadvantaged persons.
RCON 720.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: RCON 601 and RCON 711 or equivalents.
RCON 720.subject: RCON
RCON 720.title: Group Counseling in Rehabilitation Settings

RCON 725.description: Career counseling theories, processes, and techniques, with emphasis on persons with disabilities and vocational placement. Identification of values, interests, abilities, and methods for obtaining, organizing, and utilizing career information to enable career success of persons with disabilities and disadvantagement.
RCON 725.subject: RCON
RCON 725.title: Career Counseling Theories and the World of Work

RCON 733.description: Medical and psychosocial aspects of chronic illness and disability, including physical, psychological, social, and educational impacts of disability. Functional limitations and impact on employment, family/social life, and daily living. Approaches to treatment, prevention, and an overview of adaptive measures to enhance functioning and overall quality of life.
RCON 733.subject: RCON
RCON 733.title: Medical and Psychosocial Aspects of Disability

RCON 734.description: Professional issues and functions within the clinical rehabilitation process. Includes a detailed exploration of the case management process, independent provider status, expert witness status, forensic rehabilitation, life care planning, and managed care systems. Addresses emerging professional issues.
RCON 734.subject: RCON
RCON 734.title: Professional Issues in Clinical Rehabilitation Counseling

RCON 735.description: Explores leadership skills, traits, and theories, and their relevance in helping and health professions and rehabilitation.
RCON 735.subject: RCON
RCON 735.title: Leadership in Rehabilitation and the Helping and Healthcare Professions

RCON 780.description: Examines career development, theory, and strategies for advanced career counseling practice. Focus on employment trends and labor market information and resources to address the unique needs of individuals across the lifespan. Explores organizational behavior to understand the role individuals and groups have on behavior within organizations and its application in career counseling.
RCON 780.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in RCON 725.
RCON 780.subject: RCON
RCON 780.title: Advanced Career Counseling and the World of Work

RCON 880.description: Supervised counseling experience in an approved institution or agency.
RCON 880.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in RCON 720.
RCON 880.subject: RCON
RCON 880.title: Practicum in Counseling and Rehabilitation

RCON 883.description: Supervised counseling experience in a work setting suitable for a clinical rehabilitation counselor.
RCON 883.subject: RCON
RCON 883.title: Internship in Clinical Rehabilitation Counseling

RCON 884.description: Supervised counseling experience in a work setting suitable for an addiction counselor.
RCON 884.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in RCON 880.
RCON 884.subject: RCON
RCON 884.title: Internship in Clinical Addiction Counseling

RCON 885.description: Supervised counseling experience in a work setting suitable for a career counselor.
RCON 885.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in RCON 880.
RCON 885.subject: RCON
RCON 885.title: Internship in Career Counseling
